dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: The corrected engine now completes substantially stronger bounded build/judge/repair cycles, but the evidence is still controlled benchmark work rather than a clean unattended customer order from intake through delivery.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: The latest runs survive malformed model output and close many deterministic defects, but repeatability is not proven and the correction cycle still exposed a full-disk run loss, an unrecoverable closure reply, and category-specific convergence gaps.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: The purchase-to-billing chain is implemented and one corrected ecommerce build cleared the full website delivery gate, but no verified paying external customer has completed the end-to-end fulfillment path.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: Generation, image staging, alternative candidates, truth repair and jury-driven structural repair are materially stronger, but the agents still do not follow every visual-grammar instruction consistently and model replies still require substantial deterministic repair.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: With the corrected text-blind judge unchanged, ecommerce shipped, esthetics reached above-family standing and home service reached parity, but Linden and Northgate each have only one at-or-above result and broad repeatability is explicitly not yet established.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: Activation, entitlement, billing and fulfillment infrastructure are strong, but there is still no paid completion and the public site currently exposes conflicting prices between the authoritative offer and older worker/custom pages.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable lead-to-paid acquisition loop is proven, Stromation still reports no customers, and inconsistent public pricing creates avoidable conversion friction.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue exist yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and its last property retired.

changed: The single biggest change is a positive rebound in Website Builder evidence after yesterday's text-blind reality check. With the corrected judge, certification and shipping thresholds held fixed, Phase 6 through 6.6 changed the generator rather than the evaluator: the initial corrected batch improved blind decided dimensions from 18 won / 90 lost in Phase 5 to 50 won / 44 lost, Harrow & Vale became the first build in the program to clear the full gate, Linden later reached above-family standing, and Northgate reached family parity. PR #188 merged those changes to main. This materially raises Website Builder, fulfillment, agent and reliability confidence, but not back to mature autonomy because the work remains controlled/operator-orchestrated and repeatability is explicitly unproven.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 16-17 main-branch state through merged PR #188, the Phase 6/6.5/6.6 controlled text-blind results with unchanged judge and shipping thresholds, successful scheduled deadman runs on the merged head, current generated proof of the purchase-to-billing customer chain, the live public offer and explicit no-customer/parked-venture disclosures, current public pricing inconsistencies, and the absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
